package.description: Control multiple Windows systems using the keyboard/mouse attached to one computer

en-US.description: Control multiple Windows systems using the keyboard/mouse attached to one computer
en-US.longDescription:
Input Director enables the control of multiple Windows systems using the keyboard/mouse attached to one computer
Switch control between systems either by hotkey or by moving the cursor to the screen edge on one computer for it to appear on the next one
Input Director supports a shared clipboard - copy on one computer, switch control, and paste
en-US.name: Input Director

zh-CN.description: 通过连接到一台电脑的键盘/鼠标控制多台 Windows 系统
zh-CN.longDescription:
Input Director 允许通过一台电脑连接的键盘/鼠标控制多台 Windows 系统
可通过热键切换控制权，或将光标移至屏幕边缘使其跳转至相邻电脑
支持共享剪贴板功能——在一台电脑复制内容，切换控制权后即可在另一台电脑粘贴
